_readme: Frame-relative SFX cues, resolved against real frame starts by scripts/wire-audio.mjs.
Every cue names its word. DIRECTION: stereo is the device. The guest's side sounds LEFT,
the team's RIGHT (the panning is baked into the assets, tools/sfx.sh); the real-time
moment is the same tap answered on the other side; the bag's swish travels right to
left with it; one service bell on 'pünktlich'; the brand chord of films 1-2 resolves.
Nothing repeats more than twice (tap and tick appear once per side).

01-split.word: (before Vorbestellen) the team's side opens from the seam, on the right

02-gast.word: vor — the order appears on the guest's side (left)

03-echtzeit.word: Echtzeit — the same order on the team's side (right)

04-abholzeit.word: steuert — the team turns the pickup time and it locks (right)

05-puenktlich.word: the bag crosses the counter, right to left
pünktlich — the service bell at the pass (centre)

09-preis.word: Neunundzwanzig — the price lands on the counter

10-anfragen.word: bontrivo — the two halves of the mark meet: the brand chord
